page.overview:
Who is Coloradisaurus?

is an extinct genus of massospondylid sauropodomorph dinosaur from the Late Triassic in what is now Argentina. Interestingly, Coloradisaurus lives with its relatives Lessemsaurus as well another prosauropod of a different branch, Riojasaurus. This dinosaur is known from two collected specimens from the Los Colorados Formation, which is where it got its name. It was also one of the dinosaurs to be discovered and named by paleontologist José Bonaparte.

Coloradisaurus is illustrated by Timothy Bradley in the Dinopedia section of Jurassic Park Institute, but hasn't received a dino card before its closure in 2006.
